evaluationRule: Map each raw positive state-changing boundary using the same XNYS evaluation-session function as the frozen Phase-1 market audit: public knowledge at or before the eligible session close maps to that close; later/non-session knowledge maps to the next XNYS session.
entryRule: Exact next XNYS session after evaluationSession; no nearest/later substitution.
developmentCohortRule: Development membership is determined by evaluationSession from 2016-01-01 through 2020-12-31 inclusive. A raw 2020 knowledge boundary mapping to a 2021 evaluation session is excluded from development.
dedupRule: Retain the first ordered event for an issuer; suppress a later event when evaluationIndex - lastRetainedEvaluationIndex <= 20. Suppressed events do not advance the retained anchor. A gap of 21 or more sessions is retained.
sameEvaluationSessionRule: Raw positive boundaries are event candidates. Multiple positive boundaries for the same issuer mapping to one evaluation session are ordered by public knowledge time; the first retained candidate anchors the issuer dedup window. This benchmark does not post-hoc collapse or optimize same-session state transitions.
